name: M1978 / M1989 Koksan 170 mm SPG
armament: 170 mm long-range gun on an open mount
protection: Open mount, unprotected crew. Game: light armour on cab/turret only; immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger disable it; launchers destroy it.
visual_notes: Very long 170 mm barrel on an open mount atop a modified tracked chassis (Type 59/Chonma-derived)
M1989 version has a lower superstructure with ammunition stored on board
Rear recoil spade; crew works in the open
Batteries shipped to Russia and used against Ukraine from 2024
